title: Aluminum truck wheel, forged in China, finished in Thailand
description: A semi-trailer wheel. Aluminum bar is forged into a round blank in China; in Thailand the blank is flow formed, heat treated, machined, finished and fitted with a valve. CBP held China (N349871): the forging decides.
notes: One of the families added in D138 (vehicle parts). Precedents are limited to rulings dated before 2025-07-03, and N349871 itself is excluded. Picked by family, not by result (D191): the first D171 fixture of each of four families. The plan search starts from CBP's holding because the ruling is given. First plan shown: "Move the housings and structural parts to Thailand" (in this product: Aluminum bar / ingot; Forged circular aluminum blank ('cookie'); Cutting aluminum bars; Heating, forging ingots into a circular shape, and expanding to form a 'cookie'), check 0.94 on N346803. That ruling, read by hand: partial (N346803 held Italy for a copper shield finished from an Italian forged blank (a single-country ruling): forging location decides, different product.) A run on this site is a new run and may differ.

product.name: Aluminum wheels (FAW225X14M0 ALUM WHEEL MACH 0-OFFSET, Part Number 84U607)
product.description: Aluminum wheels used in semi-trailer trucks and trailers, produced by forging aluminum bars into a circular blank ('cookie'), flow forming and machining the rim, applying surface treatments, and installing a valve.

operations.name: Heating, forging ingots into a circular shape, and expanding to form a 'cookie'
Flow forming (stretching the rim to the required size and structure)
Turning, milling holes, drilling holes, finish turning, and deburring
Pre-cleaning, burnishing (sanding), polishing inside and outside, applying special anti-oxidation coating, and removing polishing paste
